hypothesis_text: Extreme deviations in futures-spot basis (measured by basis_reversion, the negated 8h rolling z-score of futures-spot basis) on top-3 liquid perps (BTC, ETH, SOL) exhibit systematic mean-reversion over 30m to 4h horizons. When basis becomes sharply dislocated (|basis_reversion| > 1.5), cash-and-carry and statistical arbitrageurs actively trade to compress the spread back to parity, generating forward return momentum in the direction of the reversion (predicted_sign = 1 on positive basis_reversion when futures traded at an excessive discount, and negative return when futures traded at an excessive premium). Conditioning on aggressive taker volume and resting depth imbalance isolates the active absorption regimes where mean-reversion completes with minimal execution friction.
narrative: Who had to transact and why: In crypto perpetual futures markets, basis dislocation between perpetual swaps and spot markets arises during sharp directional moves, leveraged liquidation runs, or localized liquidity withdrawals. When perpetual futures trade at an extreme discount relative to spot (basis < -1.5 sigma), basis_reversion is positive. Leveraged shorts in the perpetual contract pay high negative funding or face imminent short squeezes, while institutional cash-and-carry desks buy the discounted perpetual futures and sell the spot asset to capture the convergence yield. Conversely, when perpetual futures trade at an extreme premium (basis > 1.5 sigma), basis_reversion is negative, prompting arbitrageurs to sell rich futures and buy spot. This structural arbitrage mechanism creates reliable price pressure toward spot parity over 30m to 4h horizons. When conditioned on order book depth (depth_imbalance_10) and taker buy ratio (taker_buy_ratio_1h), the signal distinguishes between passive absorption of dislocated flow and runaway momentum: resting book depth provides the liquidity foundation for arbitrageurs to enter, while aggressive taker flow confirms that active market participants are actively exploiting the convergence opportunity.
research_rationale: Anchor statistics: abs(basis_reversion) > 1.5 identifies 20019 matched bars (16.18% match rate), 14464 episodes, and 430 independent events across BTC, ETH, and SOL on the top3_liquid 15m panel. The underlying distribution shows mean 0.0048, std 1.0706, and symmetric balance across positive (10016) and negative (10003) bars. Autocorrelation decays rapidly (0.42 at 1 bar to 0.01 at 1 day), confirming episodic shocks rather than multi-day states. T1 projection demonstrates 421 scored days out of 430, projecting 275 T1 scored days which comfortably clears the T1 certification floor of 250 days (reaches_t1_floor: true). Gene choice and cemetery analysis: while basis_reversion is outside the classical prior table (exploratory), the cemetery records sufficient trial volume (2822 trials) with 194 T1 survivors (6.9% survival rate). Importantly, 30m and 1h horizons show superior survival rates (24.1% at 30m, 14.7% at 1h) compared to 4h (0.7%). The dominant kill codes are T0.04-IC-STAT (1725 trials) and T1.10-ICIR (428 trials). To overcome these failure modes, we condition on active trigger flow (taker_buy_ratio_1h) and resting depth absorption (depth_imbalance_10), both with coverage 1.0. Prior evidence shows spread with taker_buy_ratio_1h achieved 23.5% survival and spread with depth_imbalance_10 achieved 17.6% survival. In addition, gate_tail on both partners restricts execution to high-conviction liquidity dislocations, protecting against fee erosion. We commit full search scope to allow the automatic grid to explore these combinations under the pre-registered plan parameters.
